profile.name: NODAYSIDLE
profile.title: Independent Software Engineer & Systems Builder
profile.tagline: Turning ambiguous problems into real products and working systems.

statement.headline: A craft-driven engineering practice rooted in native performance and local-first architecture.
statement.atelier: I design, architect, and ship production-grade software across macOS native environments, high-performance desktop runtimes, and resilient web services. I avoid disposable prototypes and roadmap hype: every project in the catalogue has one clear job, a reproducible build, and working code that runs directly on hardware.
statement.craft: My work focuses on transforming unstructured, ambiguous goals into deterministic software. From low-latency audio processing and on-device Core ML to custom desktop tools and spec-driven code synthesis, I build with high agency, deep respect for platform conventions, and strict privacy by default.
statement.metricsSummary: 70+ repositories • 10+ native macOS apps • Local-first SQLite & zero unexpected telemetry.

principles.title: Ship Real Products
principles.summary: Finished tools over slide decks. If an application exists in the catalogue, it compiles cleanly, passes tests, and installs without a debug session.

principles.title: Native First
principles.summary: Build for the platform, not against it. Swift 6, AppKit, Metal, and Rust over heavy wrappers to guarantee instant responsiveness and zero memory bloat.

principles.title: Local-First by Default
principles.summary: User data lives on-device in local SQLite or filesystem storage. Cloud integrations are explicit opt-in enhancements, never architectural lock-in.

principles.title: Deterministic Quality
principles.summary: Spec-driven architectures, strict typing, and end-to-end automated validation ensure systems behave predictably across every execution.

featuredProjects.name: NODAYSIDLE Cascade v3
featuredProjects.tagline: Deterministic AI architecture engine turning one idea into five verified markdown contracts
featuredProjects.description: Spec-driven AI engineering platform that converts ambiguous product ideas into five immutable, agent-ready markdown contracts (PRD, ARD, TRD, TASKS, AGENTS). Features TypeSafe Jev viability preflights, Rust HTTPS provider boundaries, AST validation, and atomic exact-five exports across Native macOS, Tauri 2, Astro Web, and Android Compose presets.
featuredProjects.badge: Tauri 2 • Rust • TypeScript • DeepSeek • Jev Systems
highlights: Turns 1 product concept into 5 verified agent-ready contracts (PRD/ARD/TRD/TASKS/AGENTS)
TypeSafe Jev viability preflight & platform-fit healing gates
Deterministic local normalization & atomic exact-five export with SHA-256 validation

featuredProjects.name: WhisperBar
featuredProjects.tagline: Native macOS menu bar dictation with sub-150ms structured inference
featuredProjects.description: Lightweight, high-performance macOS menu-bar utility delivering instantaneous AI voice dictation to any application on your Mac. Features TypeSafe Jev System One sub-150ms inference gates, Deepgram Nova-3 live audio streaming, SuperWhisper 288-term deterministic vocabulary replacement, and hardware Keychain credential storage with zero disk audio leakage.
featuredProjects.badge: macOS 14+ • Swift 6 • Deepgram Nova-3 • TypeSafe Jev • Keychain
highlights: Sub-150ms TypeSafe Jev System One decision engine with smart refinement gate
288-term SuperWhisper technical vocabulary replacement engine
Zero third-party dependencies, strict Keychain credential isolation

featuredProjects.name: NODAYSIDLE Sonora
featuredProjects.tagline: Native desktop audio player replacing bloated Electron streaming apps
featuredProjects.description: Rethinks the desktop music player from the bare metal up to replace bloated Chromium shells. Unites Spotify, YouTube Music, and local FLAC audio into a single canvas with sample-accurate gapless playback, hardware EBU R128 loudness normalization, instant Asian lyric romanization, and <105 MB idle RAM consumption.
highlights: Solves bloated Electron memory consumption: <105 MB RAM idle vs 1.2 GB
Hardware EBU R128 loudness normalization (-14 LUFS real-time gain stage)
Unified canvas uniting local FLACs, Spotify playlists, and YouTube Music streams

featuredProjects.name: Synapse Notes
featuredProjects.tagline: Voice-to-knowledge pipeline with AI transcription, FLUX visuals & 3D Obsidian-like orbs
featuredProjects.description: Voice-first capture system with a continuous multimodal synthesis pipeline: tap the mic to record, get verbatim transcription via OpenRouter Whisper Large V3 Turbo, automatically synthesize a contextual note illustration via Replicate FLUX Schnell stored in your gallery, and navigate linked notes in an interactive 3D force-directed knowledge graph with pgvector semantic search.
featuredProjects.badge: Android (Capacitor) • Web • Whisper V3 • FLUX Schnell • Three.js
highlights: Continuous voice recording to verbatim AI note transcription pipeline
Automated FLUX Schnell visual synthesis saved directly into note gallery
Force-directed 3D knowledge graph (Three.js) + pgvector 768-dim semantic search

featuredProjects.name: NODAYSIDLE Browser
featuredProjects.tagline: Surgical, telemetry-free native macOS browser built on Swift 6 and WebKit
featuredProjects.description: Focused native macOS browser engineered with zero Electron overhead, zero trackers, and zero background analytics. Features a single @Observable @MainActor state store, native tabs with ⌘K tab palette, local session persistence, and an encrypted CryptoKit vault for private bookmark and history syncing.
highlights: 100% native Swift 6 and WebKit architecture with zero Electron footprint
Local-first persistence with encrypted CryptoKit sync vault
Zero analytics, telemetry, or application-owned browsing backend

featuredProjects.name: nodaysrammar
featuredProjects.tagline: On-device Chromium grammar and spell checker for English, Italian and Slovenian
featuredProjects.description: Chrome Manifest V3 extension that checks grammar and spelling entirely on-device for English, Italian, and Slovenian. Uses ~35k-word frequency dictionaries, deterministic grammar rules, and a small JavaScript token classifier over fixed label tables — no remote inference, no telemetry, and works offline. Sideload-only from GitHub Releases; not listed on the Chrome Web Store. MIT licensed.
highlights: On-device EN/IT/SL checking with dictionaries, rules, and a small JS classifier
Works offline with zero telemetry; settings sync only via Chrome Sync
Sideload from the release zip — not listed on the Chrome Web Store

featuredProjects.name: Kurek
featuredProjects.tagline: Voice assistant daemon for Arch Linux and Hyprland with 25 tools
featuredProjects.description: Headless voice assistant daemon for Arch Linux and Hyprland (kureksistant). Summoned via middle-click or Fn key with a ~0.8ms trigger dispatch (mock-daemon bench), 25 native tool modules, local faster-whisper speech-to-text, and ~450MB peak RAM with Whisper loaded. Requires your own DeepSeek and xAI API keys. Derived from FatihMakes' JARVIS under CC BY-NC 4.0 (non-commercial) — not MIT.
highlights: 25 native tools with ~0.8ms trigger dispatch (mock-daemon bench)
~450MB peak RAM with Whisper loaded; systemd user service on Arch/Hyprland
CC BY-NC 4.0 derivative of FatihMakes' JARVIS — bring your own DeepSeek and xAI keys

featuredProjects.name: ShareGuard
featuredProjects.tagline: Local-first macOS pre-share privacy scanner for secrets and personal data
featuredProjects.description: Native macOS pre-share privacy scanner: drop files or folders, scan locally, and review a redacted risk report for secrets, private contact details, local paths, and suspicious share targets. Heuristic on-device detectors with no network calls, no external packages, no API keys, and no telemetry. Apple Silicon DMG for macOS 14+ (app build 0.1.0, published under release v0.1.2). Proprietary.
highlights: Drag-and-drop recursive scan with redacted secret and personal-data hints
No network calls, telemetry, accounts, or cloud sync — fully local-first
Apple Silicon DMG (ShareGuard-0.1.0.dmg) from the v0.1.2 release

featuredProjects.name: NODAYSIDLE Browser for Linux
featuredProjects.tagline: Native Linux browser built with Rust, GTK 3, and WebKitGTK 4.1
featuredProjects.description: Deliberately small native Linux browser for focused browsing: Rust + GTK 3 + WebKitGTK 4.1, no Electron runtime, and no application telemetry. Ships as a 1.5MB x86_64 AppImage (host GTK 3 and WebKitGTK 4.1 required) with multi-tab browsing, in-page find, downloads, and local-first history/cookies.
highlights: Rust + GTK 3 + WebKitGTK 4.1 AppImage at 1.5MB — no Electron footprint
Multi-tab browsing, in-page find, downloads, local history and cookies
Wayland app_id / X11 WM_CLASS: com.nodaysidle.Browser
